title: Hub page
subtitle: How UAT testing works, with a link to every page to test.

content.p: This site is for testing the blocks used on this WordPress site, with the UAT Checklist plugin. Each page listed below has a How to use the block section and live examples, and its testing checklist opens in the panel.
This page and the test pages it links to are left out of the site menus, and search engines do not index them.

ol: Open a page to test from the list below.
Read How to use the block and the live examples.
Click UAT (the tick icon) in the admin bar. The Testing checklist panel opens at the side of the screen.
Work through the steps tagged Required from the top. For each one, choose Pass or Fail and click Save result.
Do the steps without the tag when you have time. Once every Required step has a result, testing that page is done.
When you choose Fail, write what happened in Comment. A Fail cannot be saved without one.
For anything that does not fit a single step, write it in Additional comments at the end of the panel.

content.p: The panel is explained step by step, with screenshots, in Using the Testing checklist.
Every tester sees the latest saved result on each step.

content.h2: Reporting an issue no step covers

content.p: A problem with a checklist step is recorded in the checklist, as above. When something goes wrong that no step covers, during UAT or after it, tell the person who asked you to test. Include these three things:

ul: The page URL: the address of the page where it happened, copied from the browser's address bar.
A screenshot: an image of the screen showing the issue.
The issue: what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead.

content.p: To take a screenshot on a Mac, press Command + Shift + 4 and drag over the area. On Windows, press the Windows key + Shift + S, drag over the area, then paste it with Ctrl + V.
Adding your browser and device (for example Chrome on Windows, or Safari on iPhone) makes the cause quicker to find.
